request_body.raw_goal: Expand my business into a second product line.
request_body.user_context: Runs wholesale textile trading, Kano. No fixed schedule — market days and travel vary week to week. High impact goal, about 5 months out. First time using an app like this. Does not want long conversations, wants useful output fast.

objectives: Identify high-demand product gaps in the Kano textile wholesale market through primary merchant feedback.
Establish reliable sourcing channels and supplier agreements for the new product category.
Validate new product viability through small-scale pilot procurement and market testing.
Integrate new inventory management and logistics workflows into existing wholesale operations.

proposed_milestones.description: Conduct market analysis to determine the specific textile niche with the highest margin potential and demand volume.
objectives: Survey current wholesale clients on unmet demand for alternative fabrics or textile types.
Perform cost-benefit analysis on top 3 potential product lines against existing logistics capacity.
Assess minimum order quantities (MOQ) and lead times required by potential new suppliers.

proposed_milestones.description: Source and vet suppliers to secure competitive wholesale pricing and quality consistency.
objectives: Establish contact with potential textile mills or distributors to request samples and price lists.
Evaluate sample quality against current store standards for durability and market acceptability.
Negotiate terms of trade including credit facilities and delivery windows.

proposed_milestones.description: Execute a small-scale pilot procurement to test sales velocity and customer feedback.
objectives: Place a limited-quantity pilot order to monitor market uptake without over-leveraging capital.
Design a feedback mechanism to capture merchant response to the new line during regular trading days.
Analyze pilot sales data to determine if the line merits full-scale integration.

proposed_milestones.description: Standardize new operational workflows for inventory tracking and warehouse storage.
objectives: Update inventory logs to include new SKUs and category tracking.
Organize warehouse space to accommodate new stock without disrupting current high-turnover textile flows.
Establish standardized reorder triggers for the new product line based on pilot-phase turnover rates.

success_metrics: Completion of a signed supply agreement for at least one new product line.
Successful sale of 80% of the initial pilot procurement stock within the first 60 days.
Establishment of documented reorder points and supplier contact lists for the new inventory.
Incorporation of new product data into existing ledger and inventory tracking systems.

request_body.raw_goal: Prepare for a trade show in 3 weeks. Need samples, pricing sheets, contacts.
request_body.user_context: Specific trade show, hard 3-week deadline. High business stakes — this is a direct revenue opportunity. Still has the product-line expansion goal active.

objectives: Curate and finalize the product sample selection specifically for trade show demonstration and distribution.
Develop and print comprehensive pricing and collateral sheets that reflect current inventory and trade show specific discounting.
Execute a targeted outreach strategy to existing and prospective contacts to secure pre-show meetings.
Standardize all logistics for booth materials and collateral to ensure seamless execution on the show floor.

proposed_milestones.description: Inventory audit and final sample selection for show display.
objectives: Review current SKU performance to prioritize high-margin or new product-line expansion items.
Secure physical inventory samples and perform quality assurance checks for aesthetic display consistency.

proposed_milestones.description: Creation and professional production of pricing and sales collateral.
objectives: Draft and design tiered pricing sheets including show-only incentives and bulk-order thresholds.
Finalize print-ready files for physical distribution, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and current lead times for print shops.

proposed_milestones.description: Stakeholder outreach and pre-show appointment scheduling.
objectives: Segment contact list into high-priority targets and current partners.
Execute email or CRM-based campaigns to solicit pre-scheduled booth visits to drive lead qualification.

proposed_milestones.description: Final logistics staging and collateral assembly.
objectives: Assemble physical media kits, business cards, and sample displays into consolidated shipping containers.
Verify all documentation, including shipping manifests and booth registration requirements, for delivery to the venue.

All pricing collateral is printed, proofed, and delivered with at least 48 hours buffer before travel.
A minimum of [X] pre-scheduled meetings confirmed via CRM/email outreach.
